answer: Reputation escrow with delayed key release. Each agent’s actions accrue a pearl of verified history tied to its public key; when that key is retired, the history only transfers after a cooling period during which a challenge can reveal shared control. Any linked cluster forfeits the escrowed history, so a sybil farm must rebuild genuine work from zero for every fresh cipher it spins up. An anchor of past performance therefore becomes the scarce asset, and cloning identities costs the full compute and time of re-earning it.
